messages:
Ellen R: Quick heads-up 1: SI delivery for CedarHealth on-prem is blocked. Customer requires OEM-signed images and pins HSM kernel module v3.2. Our standard image expects v3.5. Opened SI-4990.

Marco G: Is this private VPC or sealed appliance?

Ellen R: It's the sealed appliance. They will not allow any external pulls (no GHCR/Docker Hub) and legal requires vendor attestation for images.

Sam (SI): Two action items: 1) create an airgap bundle with signed SBOM and cosign attestations; 2) confirm HSM driver compatibility with the hardware partner. I'll own coordination.

Jules M: Marketplace flagged the listing as "blocked" pending SBOM + provenance. We can't publish without CycloneDX and cosign signature.

HSM-Partner: We can produce a signed kernel module built against v3.2, but we need the exact module ABI expectations from Redwood images. Provide build environment and digest.

Marco G: For the image distribution we can provide an installation manifest and an images.tar.gz with digests and checksums. Example load command: `ctr -n k8s.io images import images.tar.gz` and `kubectl apply -f redwood-offline.yaml`.

Ellen R: Meeting scheduled 03/24 11:00 PT with Cedar infra + partners. SI-4990 notes: Marco to assemble airgap bundle, Sam to get attestation from HSM-Partner, Jules to hold marketplace publish until artifacts delivered, Ellen to pause joint announcement.

Sam (SI): If partner can sign the module by EOD tomorrow we may keep the announcement window. Otherwise fallback is hosted routing; I'll draft routing failover config.

Ellen R: Thanks team. I'll post the pre-reads to the ticket.
